# CineVault — Full Technical & System Specification

## Platform Summary
CineVault is an open-source, client-centric entertainment platform offering a rich cinema discovery experience across movies, television series, and anime.

## Technology Stack
- **Frontend Core**: React 19, TypeScript 5.8, Vite 6
- **Animation & Transitions**: Motion (Framer Motion v12)
- **Design System**: Tailwind CSS v4, Lucide Icons, Bricolage Grotesque & Inter typefaces
- **Cloud Services**: Google Firebase (Authentication & Cloud Firestore)
- **Data Providers**: TMDB API v3, AniList GraphQL API

## Content Schema & Structures

### Movie Entity
```typescript
interface Movie {
  id: string | number;
  title: string;
  posterUrl: string | null;
  backdropUrl: string | null;
  rating: number;
  voteCount?: number;
  releaseDate: string;
  overview: string;
  genres: string[];
  media_type: 'movie' | 'tv' | 'anime';
  duration?: string;
  totalEpisodes?: number;
}
```

### Route Table
| Route Hash | Component | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `#home` | `Hero`, `MovieRow`, `FilterBar` | Discovery portal with personalized recommendations |
| `#movies` | `PageShell` | Film catalog with genre, provider, and sort filters |
| `#tvshows` | `PageShell` | Series catalog with episode/season metadata |
| `#anime` | `PageShell` | Anime hub with episode guides |
| `#mylist` | `MyList` | User's cloud-persisted watchlist |
| `#movie/:id` | `MovieDetail` | In-depth movie metadata, trailer player, cast modal |
| `#tv/:id` | `MovieDetail` | In-depth TV metadata with episode picker |
| `#ani/:id` | `AnimeDetail` | Dedicated anime layout with Japanese/Romaji titles |
| `#watch/:type/:id` | `PlayerPage` / `AnimePlayer` | Video playback interface |
| `#profiles` | `ProfileSwitcher` | Multi-user profile management |
| `#profile` | `ProfilePage` | User preferences, theme picker, and diagnostics |

## Production & SEO Standards
- **Page Titles**: Formatted as `<Page Name> — CineVault` dynamically updated per view.
- **Canonical Tags**: Automatic `<link rel="canonical">` updating.
- **Structured Data**: Schema.org JSON-LD definitions for WebSite, SearchAction, Organization, Movie, TVSeries, and BreadcrumbList.
- **Accessibility**: Skip links, ARIA labels, semantic landmark elements (`<header>`, `<main>`, `<nav>`, `<article>`, `<footer>`).
